CustomField.description: Whether the Epics view replaces this source's tasks with the epics they belong to. False means the source's work is flat and shows as itself in both views, which is never wrong; wrongly condensing would hide a card behind an epic it does not belong to. Replaced the hardcoded set in BoardSourceRules in build 08, so there is one mechanism for per-source rules rather than two.
CustomField.label: Condenses Into Epics
